items.title: VVT solenoid circuit, A bank
items.meaning: The ECM cannot drive the A bank (right side) cam timing solenoid properly, so that intake cam stops being advanced. Expect a flat feel low down, with the check engine light after two trips.
causes: PWM drive wire open, shorted or high resistance
items.note: The 2001-02 table uses P1392 for this fault. If a scanner shows this on a supercharged car, suspect the ECM or wiring, since the MY2003 guide and JTIS show no VVT hardware on it. Late XKRs are unconfirmed: the 2006 US brochure lists cam phasing.

gaps: Factory DTC tables found cover 1997 to 2003 MY only. Nothing was found for 2004 to 2006 MY, so 2003 table entries are shown with no end year. Treat them as likely, not proven, for those years.
U codes are sourced for 2003 MY only. Earlier X100s report network faults as P16xx, P17xx and B1342.
Text of the bulletin on P0780 to P0785 and P0829 (2003-05) was not read; only its title was seen, on Automotix.
The 4.0 tables name cylinders A1 to A4 and B1 to B4 but do not say which end is 1. Only the 2003 table shows cylinder 1 at the front.
The 3000 rpm cap comes from the 4.0 tables. The 2003 table only says maximum engine speed is reduced.
Many less useful airbag, seat, mirror, head restraint, parking aid and phone codes from the 2003 table were left out to keep the list usable. See the source PDF.
A Jaguar document giving a fixed reader recommendation for ABS, airbag and gearbox codes was not found. The DTC tables only name PDU and WDS.

Part links were normalised against parts.json. Brake light switch still points to brakes.pedal, conductor plate to transmission.valve-body and rotary switch to transmission.gearbox, because those have no record of their own.

VVT codes on supercharged cars: the factory table is shared with NA cars, so it lists them for both. Those records were removed because the MY2003 guide and JTIS show no VVT hardware on supercharged engines. The 2006 US brochure lists cam phasing on the XKR, so late cars stay unconfirmed.
Which camshaft sensor code the single B-bank sensor on a supercharged 4.0 logs: not confirmed. The 4.2 SC sensor layout was not confirmed.
